name: Fonelas (Spain)
description: Three vertical stripes in the proportions 1:2:1, the outer chequy of black and yellow and the central red charged with the white stela of Fonelas.
history: The flag is rectangular of 2:3, formed of three vertical stripes in the proportions 1/4, 1/2 and 1/4, the outer chequy of black and yellow and the central red with the stela of Fonelas in white.

features.role: chequy of black and yellow in the outer stripes
stylised stela of Fonelas on the red
